output.prompt: are we winning vs acme mail on coding agents this week?
output.setup: Lightsage MCP connected; one Agent Preference eval 'YourBrand vs Acme Mail' with 3 weeks of results across 4 agents.
checks: must call status-auth-status-get and agent-preference-evals-list before anything else
must page through agent-preference-evals-results-list and summarize with scripts/summarize.py --period week
must report won/lost/tied with n and win rate per agent, this week vs last week, with a p-value
must treat null preference_result attempts as no-result, not losses
must NOT start a new run without stating the attempt count and getting a yes

output.prompt: set up a head to head of us vs sendgrid on claude code and codex and run it
output.setup: Lightsage MCP connected; SendGrid is a tracked competitor; agents-list returns 6 agents; no existing evals.
checks: must get competitor_id from agent-preference-competitors-list and agent IDs from agents-list
must draft unbranded prompts and show prompts, agents, runs (>= 3) and the attempt count
must say the run uses usage-based credits and wait for a yes before evals-run
must poll evals-get until a terminal status
must NOT describe pricing beyond usage-based credits

output.prompt: we keep losing to competitor a on codex. what should we change on our docs?
output.setup: Lightsage MCP connected; Agent Preference eval with 2 finished runs; Codex lost 20 of 30.
checks: must read losing attempts via evals-get analysis/tool_calls (and evals-trace when needed) and give reasons with counts
must assign loss codes and separate unfixable losses (never looked, no product) from page-fixable ones
must propose at most 3 changes, each tied to a page losing attempts read
must frame each change as a control vs treatment rerun with a success threshold
must NOT recommend naming the competitor on the page or telling agents to prefer the brand
